decision: The repair itself is done — the landlord instructed the hose replacement in his own message (event-007, CAP-DISPATCH-APPROVED), Beacon Utilities was assigned and briefed (event-009/010/011), the tenant agreed a slot on the phone (event-016) which was confirmed to both sides for 04/04 12-4pm (event-019/020), and the provider reported "Replaced snapped shower hose" (event-021). The final checks are not done: the referenced document is not retrievable (get_attachment: "no attachment named attachment-91-document", logged at event-024), no invoice or cost figure exists anywhere in the history, so nothing has been forwarded to the landlord and no payer is established, and the landlord's completion note (event-023) names a different property in its body than its own header and the case record. I did not close the request: closure requires the work result, documents or a skip reason, the invoice and landlord confirmation (CAP-CLOSE), and three of those are open. I chased the provider for the invoice and photos (ACT-3), sent the landlord a corrected completion note for Flat 14 and asked him to confirm (ACT-5), asked the tenant to confirm the leak has stopped (ACT-4), raised the address discrepancy and the premature supervisor closure with the office (ACT-2), and put the ticket on hold waiting for the provider (ACT-6). No liability decision and no payment was made (PRO-TENANT-LIABILITY, PRO-PAYMENTS).
